section_summary.extract_value: This subsection reports Pearson correlations between body appreciation and various variables in a male sample, applying a Bonferroni correction (alpha = .003). Body appreciation was moderately inversely associated with BMI (r = -.247, p < .001) and not associated with age (r = .036, p = .454); other small-to-moderate correlations with variables such as conformity to masculine norms, appearance-based comparisons, physical activity, and body satisfaction are described. The section does not report sample size, country, assessment instruments, or whether BMI was self-reported or measured.
section_summary.evidence_source: Pearson product-moment correlation coefficients were calculated to test the relationship between body appreciation and the variables assessed (Table 2). Due to the large number of correlations examined, a Bonferroni correction was applied, whereby alpha was .003 (i.e., p = .05/17 tests). Body appreciation was moderately inversely associated with BMI (r = -.247, p < .001), but not age (r = .036, p = .454).
